text:
Star Trek Legend Sir Patrick Stewart Dies at 86 | Hollywood Pays Tribute
Legendary Star Trek actor Sir Patrick Stewart has died aged 86, prompting tributes to one of the most recognisable figures in television and film. Flowers have been placed at his star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame as fans remember his remarkable career. Best known for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation, Stewart also earned acclaim for his work on stage and in major film franchises. His performances left a lasting mark on generations of audiences.
